text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Integral action accumulates error and can remove a constant tracking offset

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Top signals illustrate integration separately; bottom curves are closed-loop unit-step responses for the stated plant and controllers. Integral action
removes constant offset only when the loop remains stable and feasible. It can slow settling or increase ringing; actuator saturation can accumulate
